about: Effective-dated rules (scope-v1 module 3 acceptance; .claude/rules/money.md): a rule such as a table type's rake cap changes from a moment on, and every moment takes the rule in force then, the newest one whose start is not after it. A rule in force since the venue opened starts at the beginning of time. The changes still to come are those that start after the moment, soonest first. So a hand played before a change keeps the rule it was played under. Times are India time (IST); history entries are separated by |, each a start and the cap from then.

cases.description: A second before the first change: the opening ₹6,000 cap, and ₹7,000 next at 10:00.
At the change, to the second: ₹7,000, and ₹5,000 next at 13:00.
A second before the second change: still ₹7,000.
At the second change: ₹5,000, with nothing to come.
The history in any order gives the same answer: the newest start that is not after the moment.
No rule yet in force: no cap until the first one starts.
